The Living Lab is a world class educational facility created in a partnership with the San Diego Unified School District SDUSD. In connection with this project, Ocean Discovery Institute contributed approximately 5 million and SDUSD contributed approximately 11 million toward the construction and development of The Living Lab. In 2018, The Living Lab was open and Ocean Discovery obtained the exclusive right to use the facility to provide services to the community. The Living Lab is currently owned by SDUSD and operated by Ocean Discovery Institute. In accordance with the terms of the partnership with SDUSD, Ocean Discovery will obtain title of the property at the end of its estimated useful life 40 years in exchange for providing program services to SDUSD students. As such, the cost of the building was recognized as an asset by Ocean Discovery and the value of the services to render reflected as a lease liability. Such liability is reduced ratably over the 40 year term, there is no obligation for a cash settlement. The recognition of the revenue and reduction of the lease liability matches the 40 year period of services obligated under the agreement necessary for the ownership of The Living Lab to transfer to Ocean Discovery Institute.
